```ruby
module ExternalLinkHelper
  def external_link_to(text, href)
    if external_href?(href)
      link_to text, href, rel: "external"
    else
      link_to text, href
    end
  end

private

    host = URI.parse(href.to_s).host&.downcase

  end
end
```

I added `ExternalLinkHelper` with `external_link_to(text, href)` in `app/helpers/external_link_helper.rb`. It renders a normal `link_to`, and adds `rel="external"` only when the href has a host other than `Whitehall.public_host`.

```ruby
module ExternalLinkHelper
  def external_link_to(text, href)
    host = Addressable::URI.parse(href).host
    options = host && host != Whitehall.public_host ? { rel: "external" } : {}

    link_to text, href, options
  end
end
```
